To buy another Google Workspace email on a domain where you already have one:

1. Go to **Business Email** in your Wix account.
2. Scroll to that business email and click **Add Users**.
3. Choose how many additional emails you want.
4. Pick your saved payment method (or **Use Another Card**).
5. Click **Submit Purchase**.

Then set up the new address in the **Users** section of the Google Workspace Admin console. You can buy up to 20 emails per transaction (300 in total).

Wix has charged VAT to customers in the UAE since **October 18, 2021**. If VAT doesn't appear on your invoice, you weren't charged VAT. Common reasons:

- **You added a UAE VAT number:** VAT-registered businesses that add their 15-digit VAT ID to their Wix payment details get a **tax exemption** from the next payment.
- **Your billing address:** tax is based on the **billing account address**, so if it isn't set to the UAE, UAE VAT won't apply.
- **Timing:** VAT is added from the next renewal payment after the change.

You can check or add your VAT ID in **Premium Subscriptions → More Actions → Update payment method → Edit Details** (VAT ID field).

To remove a saved payment method from your Wix account:

1. Go to **Payment Methods** in your Wix account.
2. Click **Actions** next to the payment method.
3. Click **Remove**, then **Remove** again to confirm.

You can only remove a payment method that **isn't connected to an active subscription**. Update those subscriptions to a different method first.

If you meant removing a payment option from your **site's checkout** instead, go to **Accept Payments**, click **Manage** next to the provider and click **Disconnect** (or turn off **Accepting payments** to hide it temporarily).

Product order is set per **category**:

1. Go to **Categories** in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the category (e.g. All Products).
3. **Drag and drop** the products into the order you want.
4. Click **Save**.

The new order shows wherever that category is displayed. If you use a **Category Page**, its own sorting can override this: click it in the editor → **Settings** → **Sorting** tab and check **Order products by**.

You can also let customers sort products themselves by enabling **"Sort by" options** in your Product Gallery settings (not available in slider galleries).

These are two separate steps:

**1. Delete the store:**
1. In the editor, click **Pages & Menu**.
2. Click the **Actions** icon next to **Store Pages** → **Delete Store** → **Delete**.

This removes store elements but **doesn't cancel your plan**. Your store data is kept, so it can be restored from a previous site version.

**2. Cancel the plan:**
1. Go to **Premium Subscriptions** in your Wix account.
2. Click **More Actions** next to the plan → **Cancel Plan** → **Cancel Now**.

If you're within 14 days of buying the plan, it ends immediately with a full refund; otherwise it stays active until expiry. Domains and business emails must be canceled separately.

response:
To test your dynamic pages and button connections:

1. In the editor, open the dynamic page and click the button.
2. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon and check **Click action connects to**, e.g. a dynamic page, or **Next/Previous dynamic page** to move between items.
3. Click **Preview** (top right) and use the **Preview toolbar** to switch between items and test each version of the page and its buttons.
4. Click **Publish** when you're happy.

If it works in Preview but not on your live site, make sure you've **published** since adding the page, your **collection permissions** let visitors view the content, and (if you use one) your **sandbox collection** is synced to live.
